name: TC-LMC-09: switching tabs updates View All destination URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [hi] TC-LMC-09: switching tabs updates View All destination URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-09
**Title:** Switching tabs updates View All destination URL
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Switch through each category tab and confirm View All points to the correct listing URL for that tab.

**Expected Result:**
For every tab, View All href matches the expected category listing path from test data.

**Steps:**
1. Open Latest Models by Category
2. Open each category tab
3. Verify View All href for that tab
